entries.title: Penangkapan Pangeran Diponegoro
entries.summary: Raden Saleh painted this work in 1857, depicting the arrest of Prince Diponegoro by Dutch forces under General De Kock at Magelang in 1830, the event that ended the Java War. The solemn and tense scene centers on Diponegoro's white robe against Dutch military uniforms, while his followers kneel in grief, a composition read as dignity under colonial power rather than surrender.

visual_cues.composition: crowded veranda scene, main figure center left on steps, officers left and center, kneeling followers in foreground, carriage right, mountains in background right, columned porch, seated men fill the lower edge, seated crowd fills the lower foreground, palm tree beside blue mountains in the background

identity_evidence: Diponegoro in white robe and green turban standing on veranda steps

followers kneeling and bowing in grief in the foreground
horse-drawn carriage waiting at right
colonial mansion with white pillars and mountains behind

entries.title: Self-Portrait (Potret Diri)
entries.summary: Affandi painted this self-portrait in 1975, showing his aged face in profile with eyes lowered and wild grey hair and beard. The swirling impasto, made by squeezing paint directly from the tube and shaping it by hand, turns aging and introspection into visible movement across the forehead, skin, and hair.

visual_cues.composition: close-up three-quarter profile head filling the frame against a plain beige background, large head in center, wild hair on the left, face turning toward the right edge, signature top right

identity_evidence: signature and date 75 at top right
direct tube-paint impasto technique
swirling expressive lines across face and hair
elderly self portrait with lowered eyes and grey beard

entries.title: La Chasse au taureau sauvage (Bull Hunt)
entries.summary: Raden Saleh painted this wild bull hunt in 1855, showing mounted hunters surrounding a black banteng that has thrown a white horse to the ground in tall savanna grass. Rearing horses, raised weapons, and the fallen rider at the center make the mood frantic, dangerous, and tense, with calm mountains far behind the struggle.

visual_cues.composition: chaotic hunt scene at center, large black bull at the center surrounded by rearing and fallen horses and mounted hunters on left and right, black bull attacking fallen horse in middle, tall grass in foreground, hills and mountains in background

identity_evidence: black wild bull at center attacking a fallen white horse
mounted hunters surrounding the bull from both sides
fallen rider beneath the horse at center
hunting dog at lower left
savanna grassland with distant mountains behind

entries.title: Perjuangan Kemerdekaan (Revolution)
entries.summary: Sudiardjo painted Perjuangan Kemerdekaan (Revolution) in 1945, the year Indonesia proclaimed its independence. Instead of a battlefield, the painting shows revolution as a dense wall of individual faces: fighters in berets and military caps, a woman at the center, and a small child below, all solemn, weary, and determined beneath handwritten words across the top.

objects: crowd of overlapping faces filling frame
visual_cues.composition: crowd of faces filling the whole frame, overlapping heads packed in rows, larger faces at center, faces cropped at edges, handwritten text across top

identity_evidence: dense wall of overlapping faces filling the entire canvas
fighters wearing berets and military caps among civilians
woman and small child among the men's faces
handwritten inscription across the top edge
rough expressive brushwork in earth browns

entries.title: The Mystical Borobudur
entries.summary: Srihadi Soedarsono painted The Mystical Borobudur in 2019, returning to the temple he depicted throughout his career as a symbol of spiritual endurance. Borobudur appears as a dark silhouette on a hill beneath a full moon, lit from behind by a band of pale light, while one small solitary figure sits in the empty golden field below. The mood is serene, mystical, and meditative.

visual_cues.composition: vast dark sky above, moon at top center, temple silhouette on hill at center horizon, band of light behind hill, empty golden field below, small figure lower left foreground

identity_evidence: Borobudur temple silhouette on a hill at the horizon
full moon centered in a vast dark night sky
band of pale light glowing behind the temple
single small figure alone in an empty golden field
